pairs.name: Storm Spirit
pairs.reason: While Storm may struggle against Sniper early on, he can dominate in the mid to late game using Ball Lightning and Electric Vortex to quickly close the gap and burst Sniper down.

pairs.name: Centaur Warrunner
pairs.reason: Centaur Warrunner is naturally tanky, and with Blade Mail and his passive Retaliate, he can reflect a lot of Sniper’s damage. As a frequent Blink Dagger buyer, he can close the distance easily and punish Sniper. His ultimate, Stampede, helps his team initiate or escape, making him an effective counter to Sniper.

pairs.name: Morphling
pairs.reason: Morphling can turn into Sniper and outdamage him with higher attack speed and agility when fully morphed. He can also chase and finish Sniper off using Waveform, making it hard for Sniper to escape or trade effectively.
